scenario: 店铺级 metafield — metafields-shop create (无需 definition_id)
input: 给店铺加一个全局 metafield：namespace 用 global，key 是 support_phone，值 400-800-1234，字符串类型

semantic_rubric: shop-owned metafield → metafields-shop, NOT metafields-resource (which is for product/order/... owners and needs a definition_id)
type set to string (documented enum: JSON | string) matching 字符串类型
value carried as the plain string 400-800-1234

notes: POST /metafields-shop; body namespace/key/type/value all required — no definition_id on the shop-level endpoint.

scenario: 商品级 metafield — metafields-resource create, owner 走 path, definition_id 走 body
input: 用已有的定义 D8899 给商品 66880 加个 metafield：namespace specs，key material，值 cotton

semantic_rubric: owner_resource=product and owner_id=66880 are PATH params via --params; definition_id D8899 / namespace / key / value go in --data
routes through the shop skill (metafields live in the shop module) even though the owner is a product
does not confuse with metafields-definition (schema management) — the definition already exists

notes: POST /metafields/{owner_resource}/{owner_id}; body requires definition_id + namespace + key + value. definition_id is required-no-default — utterance supplies it to keep one intent per case.
